verdict.rationale: Terraform ships an official, documented CLI (terraform plan, apply, show, state, import, test) with features that suit agent-driven use. These include `-auto-approve` for non-interactive applies, `-json` machine-readable output for show, and a line-delimited JSON UI message stream for long-running commands. Community users also describe their hands-on use of CLI workflows such as plans and init. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on evidence of AI agents driving the CLI in practice.
